title: Branch mine at the starting depth to collect buried coal

order.text: reste à la hauteur du point <${sx},${-depth},-4> : creuse une galerie principale de 4 blocs vers le sud, puis deux branches de 6 blocs à gauche et à droite au bout ; récupère au moins ${n} charbons

notes: The bot starts safely in a dry two-block-high chamber at the requested Y; branch_mine retains this Y when its optional absolute y argument is omitted. Minecraft yaw 0 faces south. spacing=3 means four main-tunnel blocks before the one pair of six-block branches. Coal replaces feet-level blocks in the east branch, so walking the branch collects the drops. Both branch endpoints must be dug, preventing early inventory-only success. Everything remains inside the stone arena at every seed.
